newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 28-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 28-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JANUARY 28

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-54/96 Dorsch Consult: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 of Council directive 89/665/EEC of December 21, 1989, on the coordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions relating to the application of review procedures to the award of public supply and public works contracts as amended by article 41 of Council directive 92/50/EEC of June 18, 1992, on the coordination procedures relating to the application of review procedures to the award of public service contracts. Determination of the national tribunal responsible for examining appeals provided for in directive 92/50 in the absence of an act of national transposition. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-251/95 SABEL: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 4, paragraph l(b) of Council directive 89/104/EEC of December 21, 1988, approximating member states' legislation on trademarks. Danger of confusion between a trademark composed of a word and a drawing and a trademark consisting of a drawing. Identity of the object represented by the two drawings.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-323/95 Hayes: principles of community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 7. National legislation imposing on foreigners bringing a court action the payment of a "cautio judicature solvi".

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-229/94 Deutsche Bahn v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision 94/210 of March 29, 1994, on an application procedure for articles 85 and 86 of the EC treaty. Conditions for the rail transport of maritime containers to or from Germany, with a transfer in a German, Belgian or Dutch port. Rail tariffs.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 29

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-405/95 Bioforce: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Common Customs and Excise Tariff. NC 1994 - positions 3004 (medicines) and 2208.9069 (other alcoholic beverages) - Extract of Echinacea purpurca e herba and e radice with added alcohol to prevent chills, grippes, etc. - (1000/1100 GMT) Oral procedure C-130/96 Solisnor Estaleiros Navais: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Scope of notion of turnover tax. Stamp duty ("imposto de selo") on business contracts (contract bearing on the building of a oil tanker.) - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-17/96 Badische Erfrischungs-Getraenke: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 80/777/EEC of July 15, 1980, on approximation of member states' legislation on the exploitation and marketing of natural mineral water. Notion of "properties favouring health" and "certain effects" (annex I, I Definition, nos. 1 a) and 2). Water whose properties favouring health are the result of a low sodium content.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-7/96 Perillo v/ Commission: external relations. Appeal for compensation for alleged damages endured by the claimant owing to Commission conduct in the execution of a supply contract for empty gas bottles, concluded between the claimant and the Societe Mauritanienne de Gaz in the framework of the "Programme Regional Gaz", financed by the European Development Fund.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 30

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-68/94 France v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of December 14, 1993, rendered in the framework of community checks on business mergers instituted by Council regulation 4064/89 of December 21, 1989, on checks on the operations of business mergers. - Opinion C-30/95 SCPA v/ Commission: competition. Partial annulment of Commission decision of December 14, 1993, on an application procedure for Council regulation 4064/89 of December 21, 1989, on checks on the operations of business mergers. - Opinion C-395/95-P Geotronics c/ Commission: external relations. Appeal against Court judgment (fourth chamber) rendered October 26, 1995, in case T-1B5/94, Geotronics v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision of March 10, 1994, on a contract initially granted by the Romanian government following a call for tenders from the Commission in the framework of the Phare programme.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-340/94 De Jaeck: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 14A and 14C of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Notion of "salaried activity" - activity exercised as company director in a company in which he is the sole share-holder. Salaried worker employed in a member state and exercising simultaneously a non-salaried activity in another member state of residence. - Opinion joined cases C-4/95, C-5/95 Stoeber: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Family benefits. Notion of "non-salaried worker" in the sense of article 73. Person filling the conditions of article 1(a), point 4, but not the conditions of article 1(a), point 2, second hyphen as defined in annex I, part I, point C(b). - Judgment C-139/95 Balestra: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1 and 5 of Council directive 79/7/EEC, of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters, and of article 1, 2 and 5 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Special arrangements in favour of workers for companies declared "in crisis" who, by offering the possibility of early retirement and interest on fictive contribution periods, retain a retirement age difference for men and women, allowing only women to retire at age 55, without waiting for the normal retirement age for both sexes of 60. - Judgment C-178/95 Wiljo: transport. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8, paragraph 3(c), of Council regulation 1101/89 of April 27, 1989, on structural improvement in internal navigation. Special tax on the bringing into service of newly built boats. Exclusion of "specialised boats". Notion. - Judgment C-221/95 Hervein: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 14A, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Notion of "non-salaried activity". Independent worker exercising the same activity (company director) on the territories of two member states. - Oral procedure joined cases C-286/94, C-340/95, C-401/95, C-47/96 Garage Molenheide: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 18, paragraph 4 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National law allowing seizure of goods against the sum due by a company by the VAT administration in cases of presumed tax fraud.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-283/95 Fischer: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11 A, paragraph 1(a) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Application on the illegal organisation of games of chance. Roulette - total bets or the difference between chips sold and chips cashed. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-386/95 Eker: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1, first hyphen of decision 1/80 of the Turkey/EEC association council. Right to the renewal of a work permit from the same employer after one year of regular employment. Notion of regular employment. Employment with several successive employers.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-117/95 Corman v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of article 1, point 4 of Commission regulation 455/95 of February 28, 1995, amending regulation 570/88 on cut-price sale of butter and the granting of an aid on butter and concentrated butter intended for the pastry, ice cream and other food products, as regards the definition of butter eligible for community aid.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 4-6
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 4

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-9/95, C-23/95, C-156/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. - Judgment joined cases C-71/95, C-155/95, C-271/95 Belgium v/ Commission: agriculture. - Opinion C-345/95 France v/ Parliament: company law. - Oral procedure C-122/95 Germany v/ Council: external relations. - Oral procedure joined cases C-364/95, C-365/95 T. Port: agriculture. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-392/95 Parliament v/ Council: approximation of legislation.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-212/95 Oficemen v/ Commission: trade policy.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-267/94 Oleifiei Italiani v/ Commission: agriculture.
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 5

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-337/95 Parfums Christian Dior: free movement of goods. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-129/96 Inter-Environment Wallonie: environment and consumers.
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 6
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-64/96, C-65/96 Uecker: free movement of persons.
FOURTH CHAMBER (1530/1430 GMT) - Oral procedure C-201/96 LTM: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-205/96 commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-39/96 Free Record Shop: competition. - Oral procedure C-244/95 Moskof: agriculture. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-26/96 Rotexchemie: trade policy. - (1600/1500 GMT) Oral procedure C-90/96 Petrie: free movement of persons.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-80/95 Harnas & Helm: taxation. - Judgment C-247/95 Marktgemeinde Welden: taxation. - Opinion C-110/95 Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-14/96 Denuit: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-56/96 VT4: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-144/96 Cirotti: free movement of persons.
